_note: Starting content for new games (edit it in the question builder). Never put real election dates here; keep the [PLACEHOLDERS] for the host to fill in. Voting content is only about how to prepare to vote, never who to vote for.

questions.prompt: Before Election Day, what should you check first?
options: Which momo place is open late
A friend's post about the election
What time polls close in another state
questions.trail_fact: In North Carolina, look yourself up with the Voter Search on ncsbe.gov. Registered somewhere else? vote.gov has every state's info.

questions.prompt: Your team wants to vote early in Greensboro. Which source do you trust for sites and hours?
options: The Early Voting Site Search on ncsbe.gov
A flyer from last year's election
A post shared on social media
questions.trail_fact: Early voting sites and hours can change every election. Check ncsbe.gov or your county board of elections (Guilford County for Greensboro).

questions.prompt: Dashain, Nepal's biggest festival, lasts how many days?
questions.trail_fact: Families gather for Dashain, and elders give tika and blessings. It celebrates good winning over evil.

questions.prompt: One day left before the election. Explain your team's full plan: when you'll vote, how you'll get there, what you need to bring, and where you'll check for updates. Then give your backup plan.

storm_cards.title: Your planned trail is closed.
storm_cards.body: A rockslide blocked the route to the next camp, and the sun sets in four hours. What does your team do now?
